events.verdict: Gafford (DAL) firms up over his right leg and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the pick on Durant (HOU).
Durant (HOU) slides his right arm across Gafford's (DAL) upper body as he attempts to defend around the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Durant (HOU) legally contests Russell's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) and Sengun (HOU) engage and disengage during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Gafford (DAL) legally contests Sengun's (HOU) driving shot attempt in the paint.
Gafford (DAL) firms up over his right leg and marginal contact occurs with Eason (HOU) as the defender moves around the pick.
Thompson (HOU) legally contests Washington's (DAL) jump shot attempt.
Gafford (DAL) and Okogie (HOU) come together during the rebounding opportunity and the contact is marginal.
Russell (DAL) initiates contact with Okogie's (HOU) right arm that affects the release of his pass.
Flagg (DAL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Christie (DAL) lowers his arms down and makes contact with Okogie's (HOU) left arm, which affects his shot attempt at the basket.
Sengun (HOU) does not make any contact with the ball while it is inside the imaginary cylinder above the rim with a chance to score.
Gafford (DAL) firms up over his right leg and marginal contact occurs with Thompson (HOU) as he defends around the pick.
Gafford (DAL) and Sengun (HOU) come together at the same spot on the floor, and the contact off-ball is marginal.
Sengun (HOU) legally contests Russell's (DAL) jump shot attempt.

Flagg (DAL) inbounds the ball within five seconds.
Durant (HOU) and Christie (DAL) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Flagg (DAL) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he moves prior to elevating for his jump shot attempt.
